parent_selection_rule: Use the preregistered governed source-policy checkpoint, identified by source run and SHA-256, rather than selecting an adaptation seed retrospectively.
evaluation_plan: Measure the declared parent checkpoint zero-shot on source default/train and all shifted conditions before adaptation.
Warm-start weights and optimizer with explicit parent lineage; simulator state resets and the run is not an exact trajectory continuation.
Evaluate each saved 5/10/30/60-minute checkpoint offline on both the adaptation target and default/train retention condition with identical evaluation seeds.
Compute forgetting only when paired before/after source-condition evaluations exist for the declared parent/child checkpoints.
Report adaptation exposure separately from all prior training time, samples and compute.
pending_reason: Source checkpoint must be finalized and identified before execution. This file defines proposed work; it is not an execution record.
scope_limit: Held-out synthetic vehicle/map parameters are not new commercial-game vehicles or maps. Real adaptation remains unmeasured.
